verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM documents Docker self-hosting (docs-8) and first-party API access with keys (docs-11), and release notes reference Kubernetes probes against /api/ping (docs-28). Together these indicate it can run as a server and be driven programmatically, but nothing documents a CLI, headless mode, or CI usage as such. Missing for 10: a documented headless/CLI mode, CI pipeline guidance or examples, a published API spec (the OpenAPI probe returned 404), and hands-on corroboration of automation use.
